[[File:Action_VI_transport_EotECR.png|thumb|right|250px|An Action VI transport]]
The '''Action series''' was a line of [[Bulk transport/Legends|bulk transports]] made by [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]]. The most well known was the [[Action VI bulk transport/Legends|Action VI transport]], the class of vessel to which the ''[[Wild Karrde]]'' belonged.
